authority: authenticated native UI-thread receipt projected to an allowlisted public seat configuration; never request settings or model-authored text
stock_fallback: No missing-required-field fallback. Explicit reviewed version-bound constants (e.g. Council fraction, FANATIC modifier, cooperative implementation) require positive source/build compatibility. Unknown/custom base rules fail.
optional_policy: omit unavailable generation priors and public roster; never infer their values from defaults

native_provenance.compatibility: read_rules bookended source-file SHA256 captured at successful load; reviewed build source digest; supported thinker.ini; loaded CRules unchanged; scenario gate
native_provenance.self_faction: MFactions[CurrentPlayerFaction] public rule fields and resolved public labels; never requested faction choice
native_provenance.research_mode: loaded Blind Research rule bit used by native research_choices; no alien-name inference
native_provenance.difficulty.name: Factions[self].diff_level via public difficulty label
native_provenance.difficulty.natural_content: native mod_psych_check uses conf.content_pop_player[global DiffLevel]; receipt calls it directly rather than substituting seat difficulty
native_provenance.difficulty.ecology: reviewed base.cpp difficulty classification using loaded seat difficulty
native_provenance.difficulty.research: loaded current costs remain authoritative; no generic difficulty multiplier
native_provenance.difficulty.se_cost: reviewed faction.cpp social_upheaval free/paid distinction using seat difficulty
native_provenance.difficulty.event_first_turn: reviewed gameturn.cpp formula 75 - loaded global DiffLevel*10
native_provenance.victory.eligible: enabled loaded rules plus resolved public Progenitor identity; potential routes, not current unlocks
native_provenance.victory.supreme_fraction: reviewed version-bound 75% public Council requirement; current native candidate/defiance evidence still controls
native_provenance.victory.progenitor: Rules.subspace_gen_req and base_size_subspace_gen; reviewed game.cpp cooperative outcome
native_provenance.opening: initial CurrentTurn/base_count and loaded Look First/Time Warp; freeze at first assembly, imported positions omit irrelevant clauses
native_provenance.participants: alive factions with self commlink, only if complete public roster at initial assembly; freeze roster thereafter; no hidden selected factions
native_provenance.world: MapAreaX/MapAreaY and generation priors MapOceanCoverage/MapErosiveForces/MapCloudCover/MapNativeLifeForms; no tile reading
